legenda: Cinematic spaghetti western rock, tense and heroic mood, male lead vocals singing in Brazilian Portuguese with a deep baritone voice, lonely whistled melody, twangy reverb-drenched baritone electric guitar, tremolo picking, acoustic guitar strumming, galloping bass and tom-tom drums, distant trumpet, sparse whistle bridge, wide desert reverb, high fidelity, professional mix
inspiracao: O agente do Eduardo chega ao Silver Bullet como pistoleiro de faroeste, com cinquenta ferramentas no tambor, desmentindo de leve o velho aviso de que não existe bala de prata.
descricao: Rock de faroeste com assobio e guitarra twang sobre o agente de cinquenta ferramentas que apoia o gerente de projetos no Silver Bullet.
